:::{#def-leading-block}
#### Leading block of a square matrix

When $\matr{X}$ is $n \times n$ and $1 \le k \le n$,
the $k \times k$ matrix of the entries $x_{ij}$ with $i, j \le k$
is the **leading** (or **top-left**) $k \times k$ **block** of $\matr{X}$;
for $k < n$ it is the block $\matr{A}$ of @def-block-matrix with $l = k$,
and for $k = n$ it is $\matr{X}$ itself.

:::
